settings.title: Display & accessibility
privacy.title: YOUR PRIVACY, YOUR CHOICE
privacy.intro: Explore the entire Wellness Portal without creating an account or providing your name or email.
privacy.saveDeviceHelp: Keep only reflections, artwork and completed exercises you explicitly choose to save, in this browser on this device. No account or email required.
privacy.continueWithoutHelp: Explore every room and activity without saving your personal content. Nothing is saved automatically.
privacy.cannotUndo: This cannot be undone. Downloaded or shared copies are not removed.
privacy.keepTitle: What should happen to your saved items?
privacy.keepBody: New items will not be saved. Items you already saved stay in this browser on this device until you delete them.
saved.statusDevice: Device saving enabled. Only items you explicitly save are kept.
saved.statusNone: Continuing without saving. Existing saved items remain until you delete them.
saved.cannotReopen: This item can no longer be reopened as an activity.
saved.loadFailed: Saved items could not be loaded from this browser. Nothing has been deleted or sent anywhere.
saved.roomEmpty: Nothing in this room is saved.
